deep_analysis:
Flat book is the correct book in this tape. BTC at 82130 sits below EMA300 (82603) for 167 consecutive candles with LEAN_BEAR linreg on every timeframe and STRONG_DOWN trend quality — a down-trend grind, not a crash (LOW volatility, volume_ratio 0.29). Zero open positions means zero wrong-side exposure right now; that is the right call until a verified bounce arms a trail.

The 24h bleed is one pattern, cleanly: mid-RSI counter-trend LONGs. 15 LONGs net -0.33 USDT (53% WR) vs only 2 SHORTs (+0.01). The kill zone is meta_rsi 50-60 LONGs: n=7, net -0.43, 43% WR — these treated a downtrend as a bounce. Worst five losses (ME -0.26, ARB -0.10, LDO -0.10, ETC -0.09, DOGE -0.05) were all LONGs at meta_rsi 46-53; the winning side on every one was SHORT or flat. The 9 winners were trailing bounce longs (profit-monster / rr_engine_trail exits), not trend-continuation longs — bounce-and-trail works, mid-RSI fade-long does not.

ai-trader+ remains the leaky signal for the same reason: 3 consecutive losses (ARB, DOGE, LDO), all LONG, all mid-RSI, all in STRONG_DOWN. Not a disable candidate — the fix is pick quality (regime alignment), not signal parameters.

Pending signal queue has finally flipped SHORT-heavy (INJ, CHIP, APT, LDO, ONDO, GRASS all SHORT) which is regime-aligned. SAND SHORT (prior ai-trader pick, 10:13) never filled. This hour: FOGO SHORT (precheck PASS all gates, RSI 53.5, ATR 1.99%, RR 1.10 penalty but not hard-blocked). No mid-RSI LONGs while BTC < EMA300 — only bounce longs with trail armed immediately.
regime_context: BTC SHORT_BIAS on both 15m and 4h scanners. Continuum BELOW EMA300 for 167 candles (price 82130 vs EMA 82603). trend_quality STRONG_DOWN, linreg_alignment 0.75 (all TFs bearish), linreg_direction LEAN_BEAR. Volatility LOW (zscore NEG, volume_regime LOW, volume_ratio 0.29) — grind, not crash. Market phase labeled RECOVERY but acceleration just FLAT after negative stretch; treat as down-tape until proven otherwise. positioning rule: SHORT or flat. LONG only on verified bounce with trail armed immediately. No blanket long ban — trailing bounce longs still print (LTC/ME/ETC/BTC wins) — but mid-RSI fade longs remain the enemy. Death-zone advisory on 45-55 SHORT RSI applies but clean RR + regime gates can override when structure is a confirmed downtrend.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED (PostgreSQL 24h, meta_rsi ground truth, n=17 closed):

PATTERN 1 — Counter-trend LONG in SHORT_BIAS tape: 15 LONG trades net -0.33 (53% WR). Kill zone meta_rsi 50-60: n=7, net -0.43, 43% WR. Worst losses: ME -0.26 (bb-bounce-v2, mRSI 53.3), ARB -0.10 (ai-trader+, 51.4), LDO -0.10 (ai-trader+, 53.6), ETC -0.09 (bb-bounce-v2, 50.0), DOGE -0.05 (ai-trader+, 46.2). WINNING side was SHORT or flat on every one. Why we weren't on it: signals fire long on RSI dip without requiring regime flip. Action: ai-trader must pick SHORT in this regime; do not approve mid-RSI LONGs while BTC < EMA300.

PATTERN 2 — SHORT scarcity: only 2 SHORTs vs 15 LONGs in a STRONG_DOWN market. The one clean SHORT win was HBAR pump-chain- (+0.07, mRSI 54.5). One SHORT loss was BTC ai-trader-pending (-0.06, no meta_rsi). WINNING side was available all day; we barely took it. Why: signal zoo is long-heavy (bb-bounce, volume-breakout, r2v2 all long-first). Action: prefer SHORT candidates in ai-trader; watch pump-chain- / volume-buildup- fills now that queue is SHORT-heavy.

PATTERN 3 — ai-trader+ regime blindness: 3 consecutive LONG losses (ARB/DOGE/LDO), all mid-RSI, all in STRONG_DOWN. Signal-level: ai-trader+ bleeding streak. Not a disable candidate — fix is pick quality (regime alignment), not signal params (brain auditor's job).

PATTERN 4 — Exit mix clean: losses are atr_sl_hit / hard_max_loss / one stale_exit (ME -0.26). No SL misplacement epidemic; losses are entry-side (wrong direction), not exit-side. Stops are doing their job; entries are not. Winning exits trail correctly (profit-monster / rr_engine_trail).
